title: Holding on, settling in, coming round

blocks.text: Holding on, settling in, coming round
у- — keeping in the state the base verb names
«выражает удерживание в том состоянии, которое названо мотивирующим глаголом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of у-. Its examples: удержать, усидеть, устоять, утерпеть.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to retain, to hold, to withhold; to balance, to place or set an object so that it does not fall
to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast; to resist, to withstand, to stand up (against)
to hold oneself back, to restrain oneself

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 5 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).
за- — describing an action that implies the existence of barriers, obstacles, or hindrance

(used with verbs) describing an action that implies the existence of barriers, obstacles, or hindrance — за- + баллоти́ровать (“to vote (for someone)”) → забаллоти́ровать (“to fail to elect”); за- + держа́ть (“to hold, keep, support”) → задержа́ть (“to detain, delay”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).
у- — settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long

«выражает основательное, удобное или долгое размещение, устраивание объекта действия где-либо посредством действия, названного мотивирующим глаголом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of у-. Its examples: усесться, улечься, устроиться.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to sit down (comfortably), to take a seat
to settle down, to get settled; to turn out right, to get fine, to be OK

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 10 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).
о- — returning to the original state
«восстановления исходного состояния» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of о-. Its examples: оправиться, очухаться, оклематься, опомниться, одуматься.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to recover, to pick up; (clothes) to put in order
to come to one's senses, to collect oneself; to regain consciousness
to think better of it, to change one's mind; to come to one's senses

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).
о- — prefix added to verbs, with the suffix -ся: to recover from (some action)

prefix added to verbs, with the suffix -ся: to recover from (some action) — о- + ду́мать (“to think”) + -ся → оду́маться (“to change one's mind”); о- + по́мнить (“to remember”) + -ся → опо́мниться (“to regain consciousness”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to think better of it, to change one's mind; to come to one's senses
to come to one's senses, to collect oneself; to regain consciousness

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «о-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-#Russian).
в- — giving or acquiring a status or state
«придания или приобретения статуса, состояния» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of в-. Its examples: влюбить, влюбиться, воплотить, воплотиться.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to cause (someone) to fall in love, to enamor
to fall in love (to come to have feelings of love)
to incarnate, to embody, to personify; to realize (a dream, a project, etc.)

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).
о- — turning into something, giving it particular properties

«превращения во что-либо или придания определённых свойств, признаков» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of о-. Its examples: обабиться, обогатить, обогатиться, озеленить, озолотить, оборзеть.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to enrich, to make rich; to enrich, to make worthy
